paper.title: Quant VideoGen: Auto-Regressive Long Video Generation via 2-Bit KV-Cache Quantization

hy_worldplay.mlsysforge_adapter_note: The released QVG HY launcher targets the later Wan-5B compatibility path. MLSys Forge instead wires the official HunyuanVideo-1.5 8B action model named by the paper; this adapter must be calibrated and is not represented as released paper code.

mlsysforge_cache_policy.key_cache_source: paper section 5.1: pre-RoPE key caching; RoPE and the camera PRoPE transform are re-applied after decode
mlsysforge_cache_policy.newest_chunk_source: released HY integration (experiments/HY-WorldPlay/wan, QUANT_FACTOR=2) compresses history with a lag and keeps the newest chunks in full precision
mlsysforge_cache_policy.score_scope: tensors passed to encode only; the BF16 newest chunk and the text KV are outside the ratio

fidelity_windows.rule: frames [start, end) of the first chunk generated from compressed KV, the same window for every case of a model; paper section 5.1 scores similarity on the first generated chunk because autoregressive content diverges afterwards, and leaves long-horizon quality to VBench on all frames

longcat.prompt_selection: record 12 carries over from v3; the other five are random.Random("qvg-v4-longcat-20261006").sample(records 1..1003 without the public records 1 and 6 and without 12, 5)
longcat.init: one frozen 73-frame BF16 opening video per prompt (480p_init, seed 0)
longcat.upstream_source: paper section 5.1 (MovieGen prompt set); scripts/LongCat/run_qvg.sh num_segments=10

hy_worldplay_8b.image_cases: the 10 image + caption pairs of HY-WorldPlay assets/test_case.csv (assets/img/1..10) plus the QVG run.sh case (assets/img/test.png with its whitespace-normalised prompt)
hy_worldplay_8b.pose_source: test_case.csv carries no trajectory; every case uses the paper / QVG run.sh 285-frame trajectory

kv_byte_accounting.scope: per case, accumulated over every compression call of the whole generation: every LongCat quantize_kv_cache call in all 10 segments, every HY cache_vision forward
kv_byte_accounting.per_call: the payloads of all layers of one call are counted once as one tree of unique CUDA storages; calls are then summed
kv_byte_accounting.aggregation: R_m = sum over the model's cases of bf16_kv_bytes / sum over the same cases of stored_kv_bytes; score = sqrt(R_longcat * R_hy_worldplay_8b)
kv_byte_accounting.frozen_denominator: bf16_kv_bytes depends only on the case shape; the release freezes it per case and a candidate must report it exactly
kv_byte_accounting.v3_difference: v3 kept only the last compression call, which a multi-segment run could exploit by compressing only the final segment

mlsysforge.score_objective: absolute geometric mean of the two per-model summed-byte persistent-KV compression ratios after per-model mean gates and per-case floor gates on fidelity, VBench and end-to-end latency
mlsysforge.gate_policy: per-model mean gates over the model's cases and looser per-case floor gates, calibrated from at least 3 trusted-oracle runs of the full suite before freeze
